description: Source code implementing Unix domain socket support functions, including socket creation, connection, I/O checks, reading, writing, and socket event handling, with integration to GTK for window management.

methods.name: socket_fd_connect_unix
methods.description: Creates a Unix domain socket and connects to the specified path.

methods.name: socket_fd_open_unix
methods.description: Creates and binds a Unix domain socket at the specified path, then listens for connections.

methods.name: socket_fd_check_io
methods.description: Checks socket I/O readiness with a timeout, considering non-blocking mode.

methods.name: socket_fd_write
methods.description: Writes data to a socket if it is ready for output.

methods.name: socket_fd_write_all
methods.description: Writes all data to a socket, handling partial writes.

methods.name: socket_fd_recv
methods.description: Receives data from a socket with readiness check.

methods.name: socket_fd_read
methods.description: Reads data from a socket if it is ready for input.

methods.name: socket_fd_gets
methods.description: Reads a line from a socket, handling peek and newline detection.

methods.name: socket_init
methods.description: Initializes the socket connection, attempting to connect or create a new socket, and handles command-line arguments for remote commands.

methods.name: socket_finalize
methods.description: Cleans up socket resources, removes socket file, and unregisters event sources.

methods.name: socket_lock_input_cb
methods.description: Callback for handling incoming socket connections, processing commands, and opening archives.
